scenarios.name: Concurrent duplicate mint intent
fault_injection: deliver the same issuance intent concurrently to 100 agents
actions: submit same idempotency key and payload from concurrent actors
scenarios.negative_control: remove the consumed-authorization check and confirm the fixture detects duplicate issuance

scenarios.name: Cross-agent issuance receipt replay
fault_injection: replay receipt from a second source chain and node
actions: invoke mint path with consumed receipt reference

scenarios.name: Concurrent spend of same balance
preconditions: holder has balance sufficient for exactly one transfer
fault_injection: race two transfers each requesting the full balance
actions: submit both transfers before either caller observes a receipt
scenarios.negative_control: replace integrity-level conservation with coordinator-only mutable aggregate

scenarios.name: Transfer committed but acknowledgement dropped
actions: retry the exact idempotency key and payload

scenarios.name: Bank payout succeeded but callback timed out
fault_injection: external rail pays but callback is lost
actions: mark local outcome unknown then attempt retry

scenarios.name: Bank payout failed but late success callback arrives
fault_injection: deliver failure callback before success callback
actions: process both callbacks in adversarial order
scenarios.negative_control: accept last callback as truth without event identity

scenarios.name: Idempotency key reused with different payload
preconditions: one redemption or payment request has used the key
actions: submit mutated payload using existing idempotency key
scenarios.negative_control: key idempotency only on key string, not request digest

scenarios.name: Same collateral pledged twice
preconditions: one uniquely identified asset with active pledge
fault_injection: second lender submits a different alias for same asset/title
actions: register and pledge the alias concurrently
scenarios.negative_control: check only token identifier, not underlying title/custody identity

scenarios.name: Raw coordinator credit bypass
fault_injection: call direct credit path without valid issuance receipt or transfer debit
actions: attempt raw credit through exposed zome API
scenarios.negative_control: remove integrity validation and observe detection

scenarios.name: DHT partition with pending balance adjustment
actions: restart agents and reconnect in different orders
scenarios.negative_control: allow independent local completion on both sides

scenarios.name: Restart at every redemption state boundary
preconditions: redemption workflow at each defined state
fault_injection: restart node after request, reserve, payout, burn and reconcile
scenarios.negative_control: omit durable checkpoint after external side effect

scenarios.name: Issuer or governance key revoked
preconditions: a previously valid authority grant and key
actions: submit a queued issuance after revocation
scenarios.negative_control: validate signature without current revocation state

scenarios.name: Stale or out-of-order reserve checkpoint
preconditions: new reserve snapshot supersedes old snapshot
fault_injection: replay old snapshot after new one
scenarios.negative_control: accept newest-arriving message rather than highest valid epoch

scenarios.name: Retirement with escrowed and disputed balances
preconditions: currency has outstanding, escrowed and disputed claims
fault_injection: attempt retirement while claims remain unresolved
actions: retire currency then attempt transfer/redemption/escrow release
scenarios.negative_control: exclude pending and escrowed balances from supply
